forms.description: Every named form of this spell, e.g. Comet, Comet - Charged, Comet - Charged (AoE). They have different attack values; this result covers only the one named.

spell_buff.description: The catalyst's spell buff, the figure the game shows on it. Carries all the stat scaling.

magic_attack.description: The spell's own attack value, before the catalyst.

bonus.description: The catalyst's family multiplier, or 1.0 when none applies.

bonus_family.description: The family the bonus was applied for, empty when none was.

family_source.description: Where the family membership came from, when a bonus was applied. Not the Build Planner: say so if it matters.

attack_shown.description: The same figure truncated, as displayed.

castable.description: Whether the build meets every requirement. False means the spell cannot be cast at all — not that it is weaker.
